//: The single-page rewrite, stated rather than inherited. Vercel's Create React App preset adds a fallback of its own, but this app's routing is load-bearing in a way that should not depend on a framework guess: `BrowserRouter` owns every path in `src/navigation.js`, so a reload on /net-worth has to be served index.html rather than a 404. Rewrites are evaluated *after* the filesystem check, so a real asset still wins and only unmatched paths fall through. It is the same rule the shell implements in `electron/main.js` — a path with no extension is a route — which is why `homepage` stays unset in package.json: setting it to "./" would fix relative assets in the shell and break every deep link here.
